quests.instruction: Which cloth-topped wagon once carried pioneer families across long, dusty trails?
quests.question: Covered Wagon
quests.hint: Think about an old wagon with a curved white cloth cover, pulled by oxen across a long trail long ago.
quests.explanation: A covered wagon is a cloth-topped wagon for long journeys. Pioneer families once traveled in a covered wagon!
quests.funFact: Families traveling by covered wagon could take many long months to complete their journey!

quests.instruction: Which traveling wagon carried a portable kitchen to cook meals for workers on the trail?
quests.question: Chuck Wagon
quests.hint: Think about an old wagon fitted out like a tiny kitchen, cooking meals for cowboys traveling on the trail.
quests.explanation: A chuck wagon is a wagon with a portable kitchen. Chuck wagons cooked meals for travelers out on the trail!
quests.funFact: A chuck wagon's back panel folded down to become a cook's very own kitchen counter!

quests.instruction: Which simple wheeled cart is pulled slowly along by a strong ox?
quests.question: Ox Cart
quests.hint: Think about a simple wooden cart pulled slowly and steadily by a large, strong ox.
quests.explanation: An ox cart is a wheeled cart pulled by an ox. Ox carts have carried goods slowly for thousands of years!
quests.funFact: An ox is incredibly strong, able to pull a heavy cart for many hours without stopping!

quests.instruction: Which sled is pulled across snow by a team of running dogs?
quests.question: Dog Sled
quests.hint: Think about a sled gliding over snow, pulled by a whole team of strong dogs running together.
quests.explanation: A dog sled is a sled pulled by a team of dogs. Dog sleds glide across deep snow in cold, icy places!
quests.funFact: A team of sled dogs works together perfectly, each dog trained for its own special job!

quests.instruction: Which animal carries riders and cargo across hot, sandy deserts?
quests.question: Camel
quests.hint: Think about the humped animal that carries people and goods steadily across a hot, sandy desert.
quests.explanation: A camel is an animal that carries riders across deserts. Camels are perfectly suited for hot, sandy travel!
quests.funFact: A camel's hump stores fat, not water, which helps it survive many days without eating!

quests.instruction: Which enormous animal has carried riders on its back in a special seat for centuries?
quests.question: Elephant
quests.hint: Think about the enormous, gentle animal that carries riders high on its back in a special seat.
quests.explanation: An elephant is a huge animal used to carry riders. Elephants have carried people on their backs for centuries!
quests.funFact: An elephant is strong enough to carry several riders and cargo all at the very same time!

quests.instruction: Which small, sturdy animal carries heavy loads along narrow mountain paths?
quests.question: Donkey
quests.hint: Think about the small, sure-footed animal that carries heavy bags along narrow, rocky mountain paths.
quests.explanation: A donkey is a sturdy animal that carries heavy loads. Donkeys travel well along narrow mountain paths!
quests.funFact: A donkey's sure feet help it travel safely along narrow, rocky paths where other animals might slip!

quests.instruction: Which antlered animal pulls a sleigh across the snow in cold, northern lands?
quests.question: Reindeer
quests.hint: Think about the antlered animal that pulls a sleigh smoothly and quickly across deep northern snow.
quests.explanation: A reindeer is an antlered animal that pulls sleighs. Reindeer travel well across snowy, northern lands!
quests.funFact: A reindeer's wide hooves help it walk easily across soft, deep snow without sinking in!

quests.instruction: Which fluffy, long-necked animal carries loads along steep mountain paths in South America?
quests.question: Llama
quests.hint: Think about the fluffy, long-necked animal that carries packs steadily up steep mountain trails.
quests.explanation: A llama is a fluffy animal that carries loads in the mountains. Llamas are sure-footed on steep mountain paths!
quests.funFact: A llama can carry a heavy pack for many miles across steep, rocky mountain trails!

quests.instruction: Which strong, sure-footed animal is often used to carry heavy loads on difficult trails?
quests.question: Mule
quests.hint: Think about the strong, patient animal known for carrying heavy loads along difficult, rocky trails.
quests.explanation: A mule is a strong animal used to carry heavy loads. Mules are known for being sure-footed and patient!
quests.funFact: Mules are famous for being especially strong, patient, and sure-footed on rough trails!

quests.instruction: Which very early automobile was powered by steam instead of a gasoline engine?
quests.question: Steam Car
quests.hint: Think about one of the very first automobiles ever built, powered by steam instead of gasoline.
quests.explanation: A steam car is an early automobile powered by steam. Steam cars were some of the first automobiles ever built!
quests.funFact: Steam cars needed time to heat up water into steam before they could even start moving!

quests.instruction: Which imagined future structure would carry cargo straight up into space along a long cable?
quests.question: Space Elevator
quests.hint: Think about a future idea for a super-tall structure that could lift cargo straight up into space on a cable.
quests.explanation: A space elevator is an imagined structure for reaching space. Space elevators could one day lift cargo along a long cable!
quests.funFact: Engineers are still researching how a space elevator's incredibly long cable could ever be built!

quests.instruction: Which giant thin sail uses sunlight instead of wind to push a spacecraft through space?
quests.question: Solar Sail
quests.hint: Think about a giant, thin, shiny sail that catches sunlight instead of wind to push a spacecraft along.
quests.explanation: A solar sail is a giant sail pushed by sunlight. Solar sails help move a spacecraft through space!
quests.funFact: A solar sail is pushed forward by the gentle pressure of light itself, with no fuel needed at all!

quests.instruction: Which small watercraft do you sit or stand on, zooming quickly across the waves?
quests.question: Jet Ski
quests.hint: Think about the small, speedy watercraft you sit or stand on, bouncing quickly across the waves.
quests.explanation: A jet ski is a small, fast watercraft. Riders sit or stand on a jet ski while zooming across the water!
quests.funFact: A jet ski uses a powerful jet of water to push itself forward instead of a spinning propeller!

quests.instruction: Which planned route does an airplane follow through the sky from takeoff to landing?
quests.question: Flight Path
quests.hint: Think about the exact planned route an airplane follows through the sky, from its start to its finish.
quests.explanation: A flight path is the planned route through the sky. Pilots follow a flight path from takeoff to landing!
quests.funFact: Air traffic controllers help make sure every flight path stays safely apart from other planes!

quests.instruction: Which marked path across the ocean do large ships follow to stay organized and safe?
quests.question: Shipping Lane
quests.hint: Think about the marked path across the wide ocean that big ships follow to avoid one another.
quests.explanation: A shipping lane is a marked ocean path for ships. Shipping lanes help keep large ships organized and safe!
quests.funFact: Following a shared shipping lane helps busy ships travel the ocean without bumping into each other!

quests.instruction: Which wide, dedicated path lets many cyclists commute quickly through a whole city?
quests.question: Bike Superhighway
quests.hint: Think about a wide, protected bike path stretching across a whole city, letting cyclists commute quickly and safely.
quests.explanation: A bike superhighway is a wide path for cyclists. Bike superhighways help cyclists commute quickly across a city!
quests.funFact: Some cities have built long bike superhighways to help more people commute safely by bicycle!

quests.instruction: Which service lets drivers park their car and then ride a bus or train the rest of the way?
quests.question: Park and Ride
quests.hint: Think about parking your car at a big lot and then hopping on a bus for the rest of your trip downtown.
quests.explanation: Park and ride lets drivers park and then use transit. Park and ride helps reduce traffic in busy city centers!
quests.funFact: Using park and ride can help a commuter avoid searching for parking in a crowded city center!

quests.instruction: Which expert designs and builds the rockets that launch spacecraft into space?
quests.question: Rocket Scientist
quests.hint: Think about the expert who carefully designs and calculates every part of a powerful rocket.
quests.explanation: A rocket scientist designs rockets for launching spacecraft. Rocket scientists calculate every detail of a rocket's design!
quests.funFact: Rocket scientists must understand math, physics, and engineering to design a safe, powerful rocket!

quests.instruction: Which crew member monitors an airplane's engines and systems during a flight?
quests.question: Flight Engineer
quests.hint: Think about the crew member watching over all the engines and systems during a long airplane flight.
quests.explanation: A flight engineer monitors a plane's engines and systems. Flight engineers help keep every flight running smoothly!
quests.funFact: A flight engineer keeps a close eye on every important system throughout an entire flight!

quests.instruction: Which crew member sends and receives important messages using a radio aboard a ship or plane?
quests.question: Radio Operator
quests.hint: Think about the crew member using a radio to send and receive important messages during a long voyage.
quests.explanation: A radio operator sends and receives messages by radio. Radio operators help ships and planes stay connected!
quests.funFact: A radio operator can send an important message for help from far out at sea!

quests.instruction: Which crew member watches carefully from a high spot to spot danger ahead of a ship?
quests.question: Lookout
quests.hint: Think about the crew member standing watch high above the deck, keeping careful eyes out for danger ahead.
quests.explanation: A lookout is a crew member who watches for danger. Lookouts keep a careful eye on the water ahead of a ship!
quests.funFact: A sharp-eyed lookout can spot trouble, like rocks or ice, long before it gets too close!

quests.instruction: Which small platform high on a ship's mast gives a lookout the best view of the sea?
quests.question: Crow's Nest
quests.hint: Think about the small, round platform high up on a ship's tallest mast, giving the best view of the horizon.
quests.explanation: A crow's nest is a high platform on a ship's mast. A lookout in the crow's nest can see very far across the sea!
quests.funFact: Standing in a crow's nest lets a sailor spot faraway land or danger long before anyone on deck could!

quests.instruction: Which large wooden wheel does a sailor turn to steer a sailing ship?
quests.question: Ship's Wheel
quests.hint: Think about the large, round wooden wheel with handles that a sailor turns to steer a tall sailing ship.
quests.explanation: A ship's wheel is a large wheel for steering a ship. Sailors turn the ship's wheel to guide it through the water!
quests.funFact: Turning a ship's wheel is connected to the rudder, which actually steers the whole ship!

quests.instruction: Which small kitchen aboard a ship or airplane is where meals are cooked?
quests.question: Galley
quests.hint: Think about the small, tidy kitchen tucked aboard a ship or plane, where the crew's meals are cooked.
quests.explanation: A galley is a small kitchen aboard a ship or plane. Meals for the crew and passengers are cooked in the galley!
quests.funFact: A ship's galley is designed to keep pots and pans from sliding around, even in rough, rolling waves!

quests.instruction: Which unmanned spacecraft travels far into space to explore and send back information?
quests.question: Space Probe
quests.hint: Think about a spacecraft with no crew aboard, traveling far out into space to explore and send back photos.
quests.explanation: A space probe is an unmanned spacecraft for exploring space. Space probes travel far to study distant planets!
quests.funFact: Some space probes have traveled so far that they have left our entire solar system!

quests.instruction: Which type of bicycle has a small motor to help riders pedal with less effort?
quests.question: Electric Bike
quests.hint: Think about a bicycle with a small, quiet motor that gives you a helpful boost while pedaling.
quests.explanation: An electric bike has a small motor to help pedaling. Electric bikes make hills and long rides feel much easier!
quests.funFact: An electric bike's motor can help a rider go farther without feeling as tired!

quests.instruction: Which cord plugs into an electric vehicle to fill its battery back up?
quests.question: Charging Cable
quests.hint: Think about the thick cord you plug into an electric car to slowly fill its battery back up overnight.
quests.explanation: A charging cable is a cord that fills an electric vehicle's battery. Electric cars are plugged in with a charging cable!
quests.funFact: A charging cable can take several hours to fully fill up a large electric car's battery!

quests.instruction: Which phone application shows drivers the fastest route and any traffic jams ahead?
quests.question: Traffic App
quests.hint: Think about the app on a phone that shows a map with red lines marking slow, jammed-up traffic ahead.
quests.explanation: A traffic app shows the fastest route and traffic jams. Drivers check a traffic app before starting a trip!
quests.funFact: A traffic app updates constantly, using information from thousands of other drivers' phones!

quests.instruction: Which small camera mounted on a car's windshield records the road while driving?
quests.question: Dashboard Camera
quests.hint: Think about the small camera stuck to the inside of a windshield, quietly recording the road the whole trip.
quests.explanation: A dashboard camera records the road while driving. Dashboard cameras help capture what happens during a trip!
quests.funFact: A dashboard camera keeps recording continuously, saving only the most recent video footage!
